immutable_ref_rules.repo_local: the recorded repository commit/tree and Git blobs; worker additions are explicitly nonrelease evidence
immutable_ref_rules.mathlib: the existing lake-manifest commit and package tree, used read-only without update, build, fetch, clone, or checkout
immutable_ref_rules.external: source credit requires a 40-hex commit plus immutable raw-source digest; a moving branch, repository result, or search hit receives no proof credit
immutable_ref_rules.search_responses: dated response hashes bind only the bounded observation and do not establish global absence or immutable proof-source identity
immutable_ref_rules.human_sources: bibliographic metadata receives no H0 credit without edition pinpoints, premise mapping, errata review, and independent acceptance

credentials_policy: Unauthenticated public endpoints only. Authentication failure, HTTP denial, rate limiting, timeout, truncation, or an index omission is recorded as an access limitation, never converted into a global negative result.
expected_negative_evidence: For each bounded query family, retain the query, scope, time, completion status, match count, response hash where available, and access limitations. A zero result is local to that source snapshot or index.
classification_policy: Compare every candidate to the literal frozen Lean expression and the intake-selected mathematical scope. Definitions and support APIs are M3/E3 at best. M1 requires immutable independently reproducible kernel closure. A direct or transitive placeholder, bodyless theorem, disallowed axiom, or material statement mismatch is M5. M0 requires exact repo-local integration and accepted trust evidence.
credit_boundary: This protocol supports a bounded formal-anchor inventory only. It cannot supply H0, R0, a GRR proof, M1/M0, AUDIT-Z, theorem completion, release, or master acceptance.
